Definition: properly, chastisement, i.e. (by implication) a halter; figuratively, restraint
BiblicalUsage: Moser is a band, a bond, a restraint — the kings say, let us break their bands asunder and cast away their cords, and God answers that He will break the yoke from Jacob's neck and burst his bonds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bands men hate are the very ones God breaks: His yoke is not the one that chokes, it is the one that frees.
